Platform.Operating system: Original: EMUI 10.1, based on Android 10 (SDK Rom), Current: EMUI 12 (international) and HarmonyOS 4.2 (China)

Cameras.Front camera: 32 MP, autofocus (not on P40), f/2.0 (P40) or f/2.2 (P40 Pro & P40 Pro+), 1080p video

Battery.Battery: P40: 3800 mAh, P40 Pro & P40 Pro+: 4200 mAh
